usageNotes: Use this to retrieve recent cluster-wide log entries (tasks, node events, and system messages aggregated across all cluster members). The caller must have the 'Sys.Syslog' privilege on '/' to see all entries — unprivileged users receive a filtered or empty result. Omit 'max' to receive the API default limit; set it explicitly when you need a larger or bounded window of recent activity.

examples.summary: Fetch the 50 most recent cluster log entries

tips: Without 'Sys.Syslog' on '/', results may be silently filtered — always verify the token/user privilege if the response is unexpectedly empty.
This endpoint aggregates logs from all cluster nodes; it is not a substitute for per-node syslog or journald output.
The 'max' minimum is 1; there is no documented upper cap, but very large values can produce slow responses on busy clusters.
